jobs.title: About SettWizMission, story, and leadership→
jobs.description: Purpose-built for better claims decisions. SettWiz makes sure insurance companies pay what's fair — not what lawyers let them get away with not paying, and not less than claimants deserve. Fair claims decisions. Faster. The claims system is strained in both directions. Some claims are overpaid because teams lack the tools to challenge unsupported demands. Others are underpaid because unrepresented claimants do not have the same leverage. SettWiz exists to help claims teams pay what is fair — accurately, consistently, and defensibly. Fair to carriers Identify unsupported damages, missing evidence, inconsistencies, and risk before settlement decisions are made. Fair to claimants Bring structure, consistency, and evidence into the process so valid claims can move faster and more transparently. Built for judgment SettWiz prepares the analysis, but the claims professional remains in control of the decision and final action. FOUNDER STORY Why we built SettWiz. Saar Meents CO-FOUNDER & CEO Avri Shilo CO-FOUNDER & CPO The gap was obvious. Claims teams are expected to reason across medical records, legal issues, liability, damages, policy language, and negotiation strategy — often with fragmented tools that were built to store claims, not understand them. Expertise needed a system. Too much claim intelligence lives in senior adjusters, outside experts, and disconnected workarounds. SettWiz turns that expertise into an evidence-linked workflow every adjuster can use. AI needed to be practical. SettWiz was built to fit real claims operations: secure, explainable, auditable, human-controlled, and able to start without replacing core systems or requiring years of historical data. Accessibility Statement
jobs.description: Back to home ACCESSIBILITY Accessibility Statement Last reviewed: May 3, 2026 Accessibility Statement Our commitment SettWiz is committed to making its services usable by the widest possible audience, including people with visual, auditory, motor, and cognitive disabilities. Accessibility is treated as an ongoing engineering quality requirement rather than a bolt-on feature. Standards we work toward SettWiz aims to conform to Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA as a global technical baseline, and to remain compatible with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. We also align our work, where relevant, with: Section 508 of the U.S. Rehabilitation Act (VPAT readiness). EN 301 549 (European accessibility requirement). Israeli Standard SI 5568 (based on WCAG 2.0 AA). These references describe the standards we actively engineer toward. They are not a claim that SettWiz has been formally certified against any of them. What is covered SettWiz public marketing website (settwiz.com). The logged-in SettWiz claim-handling application. Documents generated by SettWiz (DOCX, PDF, source/evidence packs). See "Known limitations" below for current PDF accessibility caveats. What currently supports accessibility Single "Skip to main content" link as the first focusable element on every route, moving focus into a clear landmark. and dir attributes update when the active interface language changes (Hebrew and Arabic render right-to-left; English and other supported languages render left-to-right). Visible keyboard focus styles on interactive controls across the marketing site, login, dashboard navigation, claim list, claim detail, sidebars, tabs, tables, upload, document viewer, AI analysis actions, dialogs, and settings. Honors the operating system prefers-reduced-motion setting — decorative motion, parallax, autoplay carousels, loading animations, and the 3D Knowledge Graph view are minimized for users who request reduced motion. Status indicators (e.g. "Needs Review", "High Risk", Approved/Rejected) are presented with text and icons rather than color alone. A floating accessibility widget is available on every page (bottom corner) that lets you adjust text size, enable high contrast or dark mode, emphasize links, switch to a more readable font, pause animations, enlarge the cursor, and reset everything — your choices are saved on this device. Known limitations The 3D Knowledge Graph / brain visualization is primarily a visual representation. A non-visual list/table alternative is provided alongside it; the 3D canvas itself is decorative for assistive-technology users. Generated PDFs prefer real selectable text and carry document title and language metadata. We do not currently claim formal PDF/UA conformance. When equivalent content is needed in a more assistive-technology-friendly form, the same content is also available as DOCX or HTML. Some pre-existing recorded video content does not yet have captions or transcripts. Captions will be added as the source videos are re-recorded. Third-party document viewers and embedded chat widgets may present accessibility gaps that we do not fully control. We provide alternatives where feasible (e.g. an extracted-text panel next to the visual document viewer). Ongoing effort Accessibility work at SettWiz is continuous. We run automated accessibility checks in our test suite and perform periodic manual reviews. We expect to engage an external accessibility auditor as part of preparing a formal Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT) / Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) when an enterprise customer requests one. Reporting an accessibility barrier If you encounter a part of SettWiz that you cannot use because of an accessibility barrier, please tell us. We will work with you to provide the information, service, or transaction through an alternative method, and to fix the underlying issue. When reporting an issue, it helps us if you can include: The page URL and a brief description of what you were trying to do. The assistive technology, browser, and operating system you were using. What happened, and what you expected to happen. Accessibility coordinator Name: Avri Shilo Email: avri@settwiz.com Phone: +1 773 556 1408 What we do not claim SettWiz does not claim to be "ADA compliant", "WCAG certified", "100% accessible", "legally certified", or "fully compliant worldwide". Such claims would require a formal external audit and certification we have not yet completed. jobs.title: AI-readable company profile
jobs.description: # Settwiz | AI Claims Intelligence Platform > Settwiz is an AI-powered claims intelligence platform for insurers, TPAs, and claims teams. It helps analyze insurance claim files, extract facts, identify medical and legal issues, evaluate exposure, surface inconsistencies, and generate settlement-ready outputs with source citations. Website: https://settwiz.com Product category: Insurance claims AI, claims decision support, claims automation, claims intelligence software Primary audience: Insurance carriers, TPAs, claims departments, adjusters, claims managers, litigation teams, insurance innovation teams Company: CLAIMGEEX LTD Brand: Settwiz ## What is Settwiz? Settwiz is a claims intelligence platform built for modern insurance teams. It helps insurers move from raw claim files to structured analysis, settlement evaluation, and claim-ready outputs faster and with stronger consistency. The platform analyzes documents, medical records, liability facts, damages, policy information, prior claims material, and supporting evidence in the context of the claim. It is designed to support adjusters and claims professionals, not replace them. Settwiz focuses on post-FNOL claim analysis, settlement support, claim file review, medical analysis, litigation support, and exposure evaluation across multiple lines of insurance. ## One-sentence description Settwiz helps insurers turn complex claim files into cited, structured, settlement-ready analysis across medical, legal, liability, damages, and exposure issues. ## Short description Settwiz is an AI claims workbench for insurers and TPAs. Users upload claim files, and Settwiz extracts key facts, analyzes medical records, evaluates liability and damages, highlights red flags and inconsistencies, and generates claim summaries, settlement recommendations, letters, emails, and other outputs with citations to source documents. ## Long description Settwiz is an AI-powered claims intelligence platform for insurance claim analysis and settlement decision support. The platform helps claims teams review large and complex claim files by extracting key information, connecting evidence across documents, summarizing medical records, identifying pre-existing conditions, analyzing causation, detecting inconsistencies, evaluating damages, and producing structured claim outputs. Settwiz is built for insurance workflows where accuracy, auditability, and human review are important. The platform provides source citations, lets users review generated outputs before sending or relying on them, and supports configurable claim logic by line of business and jurisdiction. Settwiz is especially relevant for claims organizations handling bodily injury, workers' compensation, disability, life, final expense, AD&D, critical illness, property, commercial, and other complex claims that require medical, legal, factual, and financial analysis. ## What Settwiz does Settwiz helps insurance teams: - Upload and analyze claim files. - Extract structured facts from claim documents. - Summarize medical records and treatment history. - Identify diagnoses, injuries, causation issues, pre-existing conditions, treatment gaps, and inconsistencies. - Analyze liability, damages, exposure, and settlement value. - Review policy information and claim-relevant coverage issues. - Detect red flags and fraud indicators. - Compare claim facts with similar cases or prior claim outcomes. - Generate settlement evaluations, claim summaries, emails, letters, motions, and other claim outputs. - Provide citations back to source documents so users can verify the analysis. - Support claim workflows across multiple lines of business and jurisdictions. ## Core capabilities ### Claim file analysis Settwiz reviews claim files and converts unstructured documents into organized claim intelligence. It identifies key parties, dates, events, injuries, treatment, liability facts, damages, policy details, and missing information. ### Medical record review Settwiz summarizes medical records in the context of the claim. It connects diagnoses, treatment, causation, prior medical history, pre-existing conditions, gaps in treatment, and medical inconsistencies with claim exposure and settlement evaluation. ### Settlement evaluation Settwiz supports settlement decision-making by analyzing liability, damages, medical evidence, wage loss, impairment, disability, offsets, comparative facts, and claim-specific risk factors. It helps claims teams produce settlement-ready recommendations with supporting citations. ### Legal and jurisdiction-aware analysis Settwiz can be configured by line of business and jurisdiction. It supports claim logic, legal frameworks, damages methodologies, and localized rules that vary by state, country, insurance line, or claim type. ### Source citations and auditability Settwiz is designed to provide citations to the underlying claim file. Users can trace the analysis back to the documents and verify the reasoning before approving or sending any output. ### Document generation Settwiz can generate claim-related documents such as summaries, settlement evaluations, demand responses, negotiation notes, emails, letters, internal memos, and other structured outputs. ### Fraud and inconsistency detection Settwiz helps identify suspicious patterns, inconsistent statements, timeline conflicts, unusual treatment patterns, contradictory evidence, and other claim red flags that may require further review. ### Workflow support Settwiz can support adjusters, claim managers, litigation teams, medical review teams, and operations teams with AI-assisted workflows. It is designed as a decision-support platform with human approval. ## Insurance lines supported Settwiz is designed to support multiple insurance lines, including: - Auto bodily injury - Workers' compensation - Short-term disability - Long-term disability - Life insurance - Final expense - Accidental death and dismemberment - Critical illness - Property claims - Comme
